nphi.title: Caribbean Antimicrobial Resistance Alliance (CARA)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA); CARPHA reference laboratories in Trinidad and Tobago, Jamaica and Saint Lucia; PAHO (parallel project)
nphi.summary: A Fleming Fund-supported partnership between UKHSA and CARPHA that expands AMR reference laboratory services and builds a region-wide digital AMR surveillance platform. It was formally launched in Barbados in May 2025.

nphi.title: CDC Caribbean and Central America Regional Office (CCAMRO)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA) and its Reference Laboratory; Council of Ministers of Health of Central America (COMISCA); Gorgas Memorial Institute; SENACYT; INDICASAT
nphi.summary: Launched in 2024 in Panama City, CDC's CCAMRO covers 21 countries, working with CARPHA, COMISCA and Panama's Gorgas Memorial Institute on early warning, surveillance, laboratory strengthening and emergency response capacity.

nphi.title: Pandemic Fund Caribbean project: integrated early warning, surveillance and laboratory systems
nphi.with: Inter-American Development Bank (implementing entity); also Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, St Kitts and Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines
nphi.summary: US$16 million Pandemic Fund grant led regionally by CARPHA for 12 member states, covering regional coordination, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce development and emergency management.

nphi.title: CDC Caribbean Regional Office
nphi.with: Caribbean ministries of health; Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA); Caribbean FETP
nphi.summary: CDC established its Caribbean Regional Office in Trinidad and Tobago in 2002 (moved to Jamaica in 2018), supporting ministries of health on HIV/TB, lab accreditation, health information systems, emergency management and a regional FETP…

nphi.title: Belmont Forum: Community collective action on climate change and the environment–health nexus
nphi.with: University College London; RAND Corporation; University of the West Indies; University of Oslo
nphi.summary: Comparative study of how volunteer community groups in Alaska and Trinidad and Tobago organise to respond to climate-related health impacts, aimed at informing health-system resilience planning.

nphi.title: Argentina–PAHO–CARICOM triangular project on AMR detection and surveillance
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI
nphi.with: CARICOM Secretariat; PAHO/WHO; SENASA; Argentine Fund for International Cooperation (FO.AR); Best-dos Santos Public Health Laboratory (Barbados) and other CARICOM national laboratories
nphi.summary: Two-year FO.AR-funded triangular cooperation (2019–2021) in which Malbrán's INEI hosted internships and trained Caribbean laboratory technologists to strengthen clinical AMR diagnosis and surveillance in 14 CARICOM countries.

nphi.title: CDC–PAHO regional course on influenza molecular diagnostics hosted by InDRE
nphi.actor: US CDC (WHO Collaborating Centre for Influenza)
nphi.with: PAHO/WHO; InDRE (host); National Influenza Centres of participating countries
nphi.summary: International training in August 2018 at Mexico's InDRE for National Influenza Centres and laboratories of 11 countries on PCR-based influenza detection, strengthening the regional GISRS network.
